verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents full-text keyword search over threads covering sender, recipients, subject and body, ranked by relevance, and threads can be retrieved per inbox or across the whole organization. That covers ranked search over the mail corpus. The allow/block Lists are an adjacent control rather than search filters, and the LangChain vector-store route is a developer building block, so neither earns credit here. missing for 10: documented search operators/query syntax, documented search filters (e.g., date/label/sender facets), any evidence on search speed/performance, explicit confirmation that search spans full history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.
you can retrieve them in two powerful ways: scoped to a single `Inbox` or across your entire `Organization`.
